column1: # NORMAN SWEEP 4 -- NB10 (bs 256) with SMALLER eta_min, under decode_seq_mean SELECTION
# OBJECTIVE. Best Occam on norman_combo pairs (additive / nonadditive panels, nocal, 5 splits,
# decode_seq_mean). Bar: sum_of_singles pd 0.8824 / 0.7757. NB10 (new default) 0.8910 / 0.7763.
# QUESTION. At bs 256 only eta_min 3e-4 (NB09 0.8785/0.7660) and 1e-3 (NB10, = lr, no decay)
# were tried. Does a LOWER floor (1e-4, 1e-5, 1e-6) help once the batch is small enough that
# Norman is no longer step-starved? (At bs 2048 every lower floor lost, NE20/NE21/NA03.)
# VARIED: eta_min. FIXED: Q02 Norman weights, 150 ep, bs 256, lr 1e-3, seed 42.
# CONTROL: NF33 = NB10 re-run. NB09/NB10 selected their checkpoint on the old `sum` val
# metric; these arms select on decode_seq_mean. NF33 separates the selection change from
# the eta_min change -- compare NF34-36 to NF33, not to NB10.
# OUTCOMES. A lower floor beats NF33 -> decay matters at small batch; update the default.
#   None does -> constant LR (NB10) stays; the floor axis is closed at bs 256.
# COST 7 arms x ~50 min (NB10 took 48 min). Walltime 3 h. NF37-39 (7e-4, 5e-4, 2e-4) added
# 2026-09-23 to fill 1e-4..1e-3; 3e-4 at bs 256 is NB09 (old selection).
